utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Oren? Do you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help however I can; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need to confirm the vehicles and tools, plus the urgent fixes list. Can you take one slot and I’ll send over what’s left?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — I heard the repair drive’s really moving along, and Gus said he can lend out tools and spare parts. If you hear anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — that’s really helpful. I’ll pass along that Gus can lend out tools and spare parts, and I’ll keep an eye out for any other updates.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks, Hana — I appreciate you passing that along. Let me know if you hear anything else on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d rather double-check the timing and what’s still needed before anyone heads over. If it’s still on, I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still not confirmed yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right — I haven’t confirmed it yet. I’m checking the timing and what they still need before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s not today anymore — the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks — Sunday at the community center works. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure on the time yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Sunday at the community center now—I’m checking school run timing before I confirm a time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye. Just let me know once the time’s set, and I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do—I’ll confirm as soon as I’ve lined up the school run timing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. Let me know if you need me to bring anything or help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can bring a shovel and some filler. I’ll meet you at the community center Sunday and you can show me the cracked spots.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Sam. I’ll meet you there Sunday and point out the cracked spots.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah! If you can bring any basic tools or spare parts, that’d be amazing — and I’m keeping the word going to everyone in the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll try to bring some basic tools and any spare parts I have. Just point me to where to drop them off, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — just bring them by my place anytime, and I’ll make sure they get to the repair drive table. Thanks for spreading the word too!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just a hand sorting donations or loading things up, if I’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works for me, Bo. I can help sort or load up—just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just let me know the time and place and I’ll swing by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo—thank you. Sunday at the community center is all set, and those hand tools, tape, and extension cords would really help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring some tape and a couple extension cords on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Cleo—thank you so much. I’ll make sure the community center is ready Sunday, and we can still use any hand tools folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve still got my ears open for the repair drive—last I heard, they were asking for tape and a couple of screwdrivers. I’ll pass along anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that would be a big help. We still need a few tools, some volunteer hands, and help sorting the donated items at the community room.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely — I’ll keep asking around for tools and see if anyone can spare a hand at the community room. I’ll pass along any extra help or supplies I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, and we’re starting with the tool table. If anything changes, I’ll let people know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anyone needs tools or spare parts for the table.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep passing that along, and I’ll keep folks pointed to the tool table for now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still catching up on the details, but I’m happy to help if there’s something specific needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — the drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m still listening for what they need most. If I hear anything about donations or volunteers, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. Just let me know if you need me to pass anything along or help out once the details are clearer.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I can ask around and see if they still need tape and a couple of screwdrivers. I’ll pass along whatever I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. I heard it’s Sunday at the community center now, so I’ll pass that along too when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll spread that around and ask if anyone can bring tape or a couple of screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — I’m still sorting through what’s needed, but I’m glad the repair drive is moving. If you see any specific gaps, let me know and I’ll follow up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out at the community center on Sunday and let you know if I spot any donation gaps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — that really helps. I appreciate you keeping an eye out on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. I’ll let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks for the update, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works for me—I’ll plan on that and wait to hear what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate it. I’ll check our list and send you the remaining needs soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s really coming together. If you need a hand, I can help spread the word on the block.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Nell — thank you. If you could spread the word, I’ll be by the community room if anyone needs me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I’ll let folks on the block know. If I hear any updates, I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, start with the tool table and sort the donated parts first. I’ll check what still needs fixing and circle back if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll start at the tool table and sort the donated parts first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just flag me if anything’s missing or if you find a big fix we should tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help however I can; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s really kind of you, Oren—thank you! We still need a few more hands and any donations you can bring would help a lot, so come by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll stop by and bring what I can. Just point me to the boxes when I get there, and I’ll help with whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. If you need anything, let me know what supplies are still short.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll note the new Sunday setup at the community center. I can still bring tools and spare parts, so let me know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—tools and spare parts should help a lot. I’ll check what’s still short and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rey—happy to help with the repair drive. I can bring a shovel and some filler; just show me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — that’s really helpful. Let’s start at the tool table, and I’ll show you where the filler can go.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I’m headed to the tool table now. Just point me to the cracked spots and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll double-check the school run timing and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center works. Please send the school run timing when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll check the school run timing and send it over as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know you’re starting with the tool table. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I’ll start with the tool table, and I’ll verify whether tape and a couple screwdrivers are still needed before I confirm anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell folks the repair drive starts with the tool table and that tape and screwdrivers are still being checked. If you confirm anything else, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s still on today — I’m a bit scattered, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I believe so — still today as far as I know. If you need help, just tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m on it, Jules — I’ll confirm the vehicle and tools soon. If anything else comes up for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — sounds good. Just to note, the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, so keep me posted on the vehicle and tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll confirm the vehicle and tools and let you know as soon as I have it.
